decisions.decision: The test split uses node:test SUBTESTS, not describe/before
decisions.rationale: No root-level test file in this repo uses describe/before, so those would be a new convention. Subtests verified by probe: an early failure does not stop later subtests and each is reported by name, while shared setup stays in the outer scope.

decisions.decision: 1099-G boxes 2/5/6/7/9 are REFUSED when non-zero, not stored-and-ignored
decisions.rationale: Box 2 is taxable only under the tax-benefit rule, which needs the prior year's return; this engine holds one year. Ignoring it would understate income for anyone who itemized last year. Box 11 is deliberately NOT refused: state withholding never reaches a federal return.

decisions.decision: inputsOf keeps ten curried parameters and defaults unemploymentForms to empty
decisions.rationale: It is a test helper. The field is REQUIRED on Form1040Inputs and tsc enforces that on production callers; defaulting in the helper left forty existing proof call sites untouched.

context_notes: The through-line of this session was one defect class appearing SIX times: a count or population that was true of the part someone examined and false of the whole. Phase 19's four pre-execution blockers, Phase 18's ROADMAP saying 'two dialect files' when it is six, and my own suite-runtime figure taken from a single sample. The prevention is not care, it is method: re-derive every population with a command that does not depend on the method that found it, because different discovery methods find different subsets. Second: three of Phase 18's mutation gates would have failed to COMPILE, which is the same failure as a vacuous proof one level up - a gate that cannot run proves nothing while appearing performed. Third, and most valuable: the engine REFUSED a real user document correctly, on the first one it ever saw, and that refusal is what produced the 1099-G feature. FOURTH, surfaced at the very end: form1040Report has NO production caller. The proven 1040 engine and the proven program-execution spine have never been joined, and cannot be by the guest path since guests cannot import. Phase 19's provenance and reproduction work has therefore never run against a real 1040. Wiring a server tool that reads stored documents and calls the engine is the highest-value unbuilt thing in the project.
